Election officials to receive allowances for 'SIR' work

Booth Level Officers (BLOs) and supervisors in Uttar Pradesh are set to receive allowances for their work related to the 'SIR' system. Orders have been issued for payments, with reports indicating amounts of several thousand rupees, including a specific mention of ₹6,000 for BLOs and supervisors for SIR work.
